terra.problem: “Philistines camp at Lehi” places the camp at Lehi, but Judges 15:9 says they camped in Judah and deployed near Lehi. The text also says they camped near Lehi, which the verse does not explicitly say.
In the first moment, the men of Judah bound Samson at the rock of Etam, not at Lehi. Samson arrived in Lehi afterward (Judges 15:13–14).
